title: Form Processing
seo: Form processing for paper and online forms
meta: Paper and online forms turned into structured records in your sheet or database, with checks built in. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Form processing that turns forms into clean records
overview: Application forms, intake sheets and signed order forms often end up as scans or messy submissions. We build a flow that reads each form, matches answers to fields, checks required items and stores one clean record per form. Online forms are connected directly, and scanned paper forms are read from a folder or email address you choose.

faq: Which online form tools do you connect?
Google Forms, Typeform, Jotform, Tally and the forms built into most website platforms. If your form tool can send data on submit, we can usually receive it.
You scan or photograph them into a folder. We read each page, match answers to your field list and flag anything unclear. Forms with ticked boxes and printed text work best.
Can you handle forms with signatures?
We can capture the signature image and store it with the record. We do not verify whether a signature is legally valid. Your team or counsel decides that.
What happens to a form with missing answers?
It is saved with a flag and listed in a review sheet, so a person can follow up with the sender instead of the record sitting half empty.
